title: Raining ducks
features:
if you want put duck.CanCollide on true to make it collide

(rejoin to remove ducks)
script: while wait(.1) do local duck = Instance.new("Part", game.Workspace) duck.Size = Vector3.new(40,40,40) local asd = Instance.new("FileMesh", duck) asd.MeshId = "rbxassetid://521754610" asd.TextureId = "rbxassetid://521754612" asd.Scale = Vector3.new(40,40,40) duck.CanCollide = false duck.CFrame = CFrame.new(math.random(-1000,1000), math.random(300,700), math.random(-1000,1000)) local quack = Instance.new("Sound", duck) quack.SoundId = "rbxassetid://2101511513" quack.Volume = 5 quack.PlaybackSpeed = 1 quack:Play() game.Debris:AddItem(quack, 0.5) end
